title: 2-in-1 Metabolite and Protein Extraction Method for Plant Multi-Omics
author: Qijie Guan
materials: Savant SPD1010 SpeedVac Concentrator System (Thermo Scientific)
Metabolite extraction buffer I (acetonitrile: isopropanol: water, 3:3:2)
1 µg/µL Bovine Serum Albumin Fraction V (BSA)
Protein Lysis solubilization solution (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 4% CHAPS, 10 mM DTT and 0.1 mM PMSF)
Vacuum drying samples with Savant SPD1010 SpeedVac Concentrator System (Thermo Scientific, Asheville, NC, USA). Savant SPD1010 SpeedVac Concentrator System (Savant, SPD1010)
Sample vacuum dried Vacuum drying samples with Savant SPD1010 SpeedVac Concentrator System (Thermo Scientific, Asheville, NC, USA). Savant SPD1010 SpeedVac Concentrator System (Savant, SPD1010)

steps.title: Collect plant tissue and freeze
steps.instruction: Weigh 150 mg plant material into each 2 mL screw‑cap tube, add a 6 mm stainless‑steel grinding ball, and immediately place tubes in liquid nitrogen (handle LN₂ with proper PPE).

steps.title: Homogenize frozen samples
steps.instruction: Keep tubes cold with liquid nitrogen, homogenize at 1000 rpm for 2 min using the HG‑400 homogenizer, adding liquid nitrogen as needed to maintain temperature.

steps.title: Extract metabolites with buffer I
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL pre‑cooled (‑20 °C) extraction buffer I (acetonitrile:isopropanol:water 3:3:2) containing 0.1 mM PMSF, remove the grinding ball with a magnetic sticker, vortex 30 s, sonicate in ice water 5 min, then centrifuge 15000 × g at 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Spike internal standards
steps.instruction: To each tube add 10 µL of 100 µM lidocaine, 10 µL of 100 µM 10‑camphorsulfonic acid, and 4 µL of 1 µg/µL BSA.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to tube A
steps.instruction: Pipette the supernatant from step 3 into a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube labeled A and store at ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Extract metabolites with buffer II
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL pre‑cooled (‑20 °C) extraction buffer II (acetonitrile:water 1:1) with 0.1 mM PMSF to the remaining pellet, vortex 30 s, sonicate 5 min on ice, centrifuge 15000 × g at 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to tube B
steps.instruction: Pipette the supernatant from step 6 into a new 1.5 mL tube labeled B and keep at ‑20 °C.

steps.title: Extract metabolites with buffer III
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL pre‑cooled (‑20 °C) extraction buffer III (80 % methanol) containing 0.1 mM PMSF to the pellet, vortex 30 s, sonicate 5 min on ice, centrifuge 15000 × g at 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to tube C
steps.instruction: Pipette the supernatant from step 8 into a new 1.5 mL tube labeled C; retain the remaining residue for protein extraction later.

steps.title: Combine and vacuum‑dry metabolite extracts
steps.instruction: Vacuum‑dry tubes A, B, and C for 1 h; then pipette the contents of tubes B and C into tube A, combine all metabolites, and continue vacuum‑drying the combined extract.

steps.title: Final vacuum dry metabolite residue
steps.instruction: Vacuum‑dry the combined metabolite extract (from step 10) for an additional 5 min to evaporate remaining methanol.

steps.title: Lyse proteins with buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL protein lysis solubilization solution (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 4 % CHAPS, 10 mM DTT, 0.1 mM PMSF) to the residue retained after step 9.

steps.title: Solubilize proteins
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube at 4 °C for 30 min, sonicate in ice water for 5 min, then centrifuge 15000 × g at 4 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Collect protein supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from step 13 to a fresh tube; this supernatant constitutes the protein solvent.
